title: Inactive-Account Repayment Plan: Installments by Size of the Unpaid Meal Charges (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
Under the district's unpaid meal charge repayment plan for an inactive account, the installments set by the size of the unpaid meal charges on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account are three (3) when they exceed twenty dollars (20.00), two (2) when they exceed five dollars (5.00) but not twenty dollars, and one (1) otherwise.

The unpaid meal charges are the amount by which the account's balance is below zero, the balance being its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the payment is quoted; an account at or above zero has none.

| Unpaid meal charges | Installments set by size |
|---|---|
| more than 20.00 | 3 |
| more than 5.00, up to and including 20.00 | 2 |
| 5.00 or less | 1 |

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical)

- 20.01 owed: three installments; 20.00 owed: two.
- 5.01 owed: two installments; 5.00 owed: one.
